notes_for_editor: Thin. Location disagreement, stated in the story and left unresolved: Forest Lookouts gives the survey code 38S-8E-18 (Klamath FPA), while the Klamath County blog gives Sec 13 T38S R7E. A human should check the land description before any location field is changed. The story runs about 100 words, below the 120-word guide floor, because no readable source adds anything about this lookout beyond the two entries; other Klamath entries on the blog are for different towers and are not used. The blog's 1930s date has no exact year, so there is no built event. Record coordinates (42.27042, -121.93834) sit about 20 m from the GNIS point for Porter Butte (42.27038, -121.93809). AllTrails has a Porter Butte listing that describes a route along a dirt, gated road; the page returned HTTP 403 to the reader and only a search snippet was seen, so it is not used. Porter Butte is not on the firelookout.org Oregon list, so no NHLR or FFLOS entry was found.
